about_the_game:
Build the retro world of your dreams: from chill vaporwave vibes to neon retrowave skylines, from 90s suburbs to futuristic cityscapes, all in the most nostalgic sandbox...

My Retro World is a creative and atmospheric sandbox where the only limit is your imagination. Inspired by the 80s and 90s, you can design your own universe: palm-lined streets, glowing arcades, futuristic skylines or dystopian districts. Every creation reflects your memories, your dreams and your vision of retro.

Create freely, explore your inspirations, share your worlds with friends and let nostalgia guide you.

✨ Features:


🏙️ Creative sandbox – place, move and combine thousands of elements to shape your retro worlds

🌆 Varied aesthetics – retrowave, vaporwave, dystopian, futuristic… every style has its place

🎨 Stylized visuals – colorful, atmospheric graphics that capture the spirit of the 80s and 90s

🎶 Immersive vibes – music and soundscapes inspired by the VHS and synthwave era

🤝 Multiplayer – build alone or together, share your creations and get inspired by others

🕹️ Accessible and relaxing – no stress, no limits, just pure creativity

🌌 An experience between nostalgia and creativity.


Whether you dream of a futuristic skyline straight out of an 80s sci-fi movie, a cozy 90s suburb or a pastel vaporwave universe, My Retro World is your playground.

Relive the past. Create your memories. Shape your retro world.

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains some stylized characters and posters with revealing outfits (e.g., swimsuits). Some in-game items reference cigarettes and alcohol.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 10/11 - 64bits
  • Processor: AMD Athlon X2 2.8 GHZ, Intel Core 2 Duo 2.4 GHZ
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon HD 6450, Nvidia GeForce GT 460
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated

  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
